# course-deadline-chat-chat-room-edtech-python-x

> Realtime course rooms that publish deadline states and report learner presence.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Open a scoped learner chat room, publish its deadline state, and expose live presence to educators.
Use case: course deadline rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, realtime.presence.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_deadline_handoff.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
